name: Firebolt
description: Fires a bolt of fire at a single target.

name: Healing
description: Restores some of the caster's health. Warriors receive double the healing.

name: Lightning
description: Calls down a lightning strike on a single target.

name: Flash
description: A bright flash of light that damages a single target.

name: Identify
description: Reveals the magical properties of an item. Cast on an item in your inventory.

name: Fire Wall
description: Creates a wall of fire that damages enemies who pass through it.

name: Town Portal
description: Opens a portal to town. The caster can return through the portal.

name: Stone Curse
description: Temporarily turns a target to stone, preventing movement and attack.

name: Infravision
description: Allows the caster to see in the dark, revealing hidden enemies.

name: Phasing
description: Instantly teleports the caster to a random nearby location.

name: Mana Shield
description: Creates a shield that absorbs damage using mana instead of health.

name: Fireball
description: A large fireball that explodes on impact, damaging all nearby enemies.

name: Guardian
description: Summons a guardian that fires at nearby enemies.

name: Chain Lightning
description: Strikes a target with lightning that chains to nearby enemies.

name: Flame Wave
description: Sends a wave of flame across the ground damaging all in its path.

name: Nova
description: Emits a ring of flame in all directions, damaging nearby enemies.

name: Inferno
description: Breathes a continuous stream of fire at enemies.

name: Golem
description: Summons a stone golem to fight for the caster.

name: Rage
description: Increases the Barbarian's attack speed and damage for a short time.

name: Teleport
description: Instantly moves the caster to the targeted location.

name: Apocalypse
description: Massive damage to all enemies on the screen. Power increases with caster level.

name: Etherealize
description: Makes the caster ethereal, reducing damage taken but preventing physical attacks.

name: Item Repair
description: Repairs an equipped item's durability. Warning: reduces maximum durability.

name: Staff Recharge
description: Recharges the charges on an equipped staff.

name: Trap Disarm
description: Disables a trap on the ground.

name: Elemental
description: Calls down a elemental from the sky to attack enemies.

name: Charged Bolt
description: Fires multiple charged bolts that seek out nearby enemies.

name: Holy Bolt
description: Fires a bolt of holy energy. Damages undead only.

name: Resurrect
description: Brings a dead player back to life with partial health.

name: Telekinesis
description: Allows the caster to pick up items and open doors from a distance.

name: Heal Other
description: Restores health to another player. Warriors receive double the healing.

name: Blood Star
description: Fires a star of blood that deals heavy damage at the cost of caster health.

name: Bone Spirit
description: Drains one third of the target's life.
